limitations: Lexical evidence is not proof of runtime behavior or semantic data flow. Comments, strings, aliases and multiline expressions may cause false positives or omissions.
A complete static pattern is a candidate only; no branch is selected for modification and no bug is corrected.
Progression terms are reported only with baby context in the same inspected file; they do not certify baby evolution.
Snapshots sharing a commit are aliases, not distinct implementations. Only bounded tracked root/src/dist text scope is inspected; skipped scope is explicit.
